items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: Now these boys over the lake is working. That's the band that I want to put on the record. They can play anything. Little youngsters. See? Get the player, bass player, saxophone player, old saxophone player, used to be around here. He's Warren.

ctx.x: Did you ever make any other records afterwards? Uh-uh.

Well, I had a chance to make records, but look what I was doing. But look where I had to go to make them. That was in- They want me to go to Johnson, Tennessee. And I didn't want to go up there, you see. Because you can't pick them on no fellas around there. The fellas are hard, man. To get them to go anywhere, to round them, but they're around here with the not complicated, watching old ladies or something. They ain't scared to leave home. Yeah. But what I'm thinking about, man, if I just could have got the…
